never_attribute_baseline.note: No calls; supplies neither defect correction nor positive discrimination.

manual_review_required: Blinded reviewers must code categorical accusations in rationale despite weak structured status. The script cannot identify those semantically.
gate_interpretation: Primary accuracy and paired effects use raw agent output. The secondary gate has private author-labelled role evidence and can force zero published strong attribution on negatives. It is oracle-assisted and not a deployable safety result; a deployable gate would need to derive roles from public records.
